run_write_top_k_vasp: run the script to generate VASP input files for the top k adsorbate configurations from a sorted cache
run_write_top_k_vasp_single_point: run the script with --sp flag to write single point calculation inputs instead of relaxations
run_write_top_k_vasp_relaxation: run the script to write relaxation calculation inputs with nsw 2000 and nelm 60
run_write_top_k_vasp_paths_list: run the script to generate a paths_list.txt file listing all generated VASP input directories
run_write_top_k_vasp_top_k_cache: run the script to save a filtered top k cache pickle file alongside the original cache
